source: The names in the tools/list answer of the SEO Genius MCP server at https://api.seogenius.ai/api/mcp/v1. scripts/check.mjs fails when a skill or doc names a tool that is not here. When the server adds, renames or removes a tool, replace this list with the names its tools/list answers and update captured_on.
not_tools_note: Names the docs use that read like a tool to the check (a list_ or get_ prefix, or call before them) but are not tools, such as a field. Keep it short; a tool the server does not have yet does not belong here.
